meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 安装后，当你交给它一个计划，Claude 会充当总指挥，把计划拆成阶段，分别派出多个子代理去实际干活。每个子代理完成后，它会安排检查、验证和代码审查，全部通过后才提交结果。它自己只负责协调和确认进度，不亲自写代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行、运行或实施某个计划时触发，尤其是由 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 请执行我们刚才定好的实施计划。
say.note: Claude 会开始分阶段安排子代理执行。

say.text: 运行这个计划，每一步验证通过再继续。
say.note: Claude 会严格按阶段推进，每步都有验证环节。

say.text: 分派子代理执行计划，并要求每步提交证据。
say.note: Claude 会让每个子代理报告实际运行结果和改动文件。

howto.what_en: Given a plan, Claude splits it into phases and deploys subagents to do the work. It verifies each phase and commits only after verification passes. It coordinates, not executes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Please execute the implementation plan we just agreed on.
say_en.note: Claude will deploy subagents to execute it in phases.

say_en.text: Run this plan and verify each step before continuing.
say_en.note: Claude proceeds phase by phase with verification at each step.

say_en.text: Assign subagents to execute the plan, requiring evidence for each step.
say_en.note: Claude will have subagents report results and changed files.
